purpose: Zero-commission full scalp-grid rerun with lot/cash reporting and separate high-spread gold sensitivity
base_inventory: All 504 variants per instrument from docs/xmi-scalping-catalog-20261107.json, without changing signal, stop, target, window, hold or risk settings

contracts.status: Modeled conversion factors, minimum and step; not a verified account-specific gold contract

cost_and_margin_status: Zero commission is the scenario correction. FX 2-pip spread/0.3-pip per-side slippage and gold 0.07-price-unit per-side slippage remain modeled. Leverage inputs are conditional scenarios. The higher gold spread is a fixed sensitivity, not measured 2022-2024 bid/ask history.
margin: Recalculate units * entry ask / leverage for USD-quoted instruments, units / leverage for USD-base; maximum 90% of cash equity. Never hardcode one displayed cash margin across historical prices.
risk: Retain independent 0.25% and 0.5% equity-risk budgets; skip below minimum lot/margin. Preserve 10% marked drawdown halt and maintenance audit.
fixed_lot_comparison: After training freeze, compare exactly 0.01 lot to each selected dynamic-size benchmark across every fold/cost. Preserve that benchmark's risk ceiling; skip the fixed lot if unaffordable, without forcing fills.
selection: Use the existing training-only scalp ranking per instrument/profile/lane: eligible first, both base training samples >=25 second, then best worst training net across years/costs, then base count; earlier catalog choice wins ties.
qualification: Positive net expectancy, PF > 1.5, DD < 10%, >=200 distinct completed untouched out-of-sample trades, stressed costs, training stability and no timing/data/margin failure. Reused 2024 and modeled contract/cost assumptions do not establish live qualification.
freeze: Persist all profile/lane training selections before any new 2024 evaluation; no reselecting on 2024
parity: Reproduce the original 24 no-filter scalp benchmarks across all four folds/three costs using the legacy model: 288 saved-account matches
public_privacy: Generic research inputs only; no personal account affiliation, screenshots, credentials, balances, vendor quote rows or individual simulated ledgers in Git
